parameters.query: SELECT e.id AS employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, e.position, e.probation_end_date, e.immediate_head, eh.email AS immediate_head_email FROM public.employees e LEFT JOIN public.users eh ON eh.id = e.immediate_head AND eh.deleted_at IS NULL AND eh.status = 'active' WHERE e.deleted_at IS NULL AND e.probation_end_date IS NOT NULL AND e.probation_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE AND e.probation_end_date <= (CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '14 day')::date ORDER BY e.probation_end_date ASC, e.last_name, e.first_name;
